subject: R has been accepted for GSOC 2022!

messages.author: c9416b6005bf4eb7
messages.subject: R has been accepted for GSOC 2022!
parts:
R is among 203 organizations that has been accepted for GSOC'22! Thanks to Vijay for submitting the Admin application.

MENTORS, please add project ideas ASAP to https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2022/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects

Students, please begin looking at that list, and submitting tests to mentors.
